name: MorphOS
description: Prompt-Synthesized Adaptive Operating System for FinTech, Cloud & Zero-Trust Security

hackathon.secondaryTrack: Track 03: Trust Issues (Failproof AI & Zero Accidental Data Loss)

architecture.engine: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Zustand

subsystems.name: Microkernel VFS
subsystems.description: POSIX-compliant in-memory virtual file system with ACLs, classification tags, and encrypted /etc /var structures

subsystems.name: SELinux & LSM Security Interceptor
subsystems.description: Kernel security module intercepting destructive signatures (rm -rf, DROP TABLE, mkfs) and enforcing PCI-DSS 4.0 Level 1 policies

subsystems.name: Window Manager (WM)
subsystems.description: Floating, magnetic snapping (Windows 11 Snap), and auto-tiling (Hyprland) compositor with capture-phase z-index management

subsystems.name: Prompt Compiler (Local + n8n + Gemini)
subsystems.description: High-precision NLP compiler synthesizing design tokens, icon packs, window geometry, and security profiles with fallback resilience

subsystems.name: Dynamic Design Token Engine
subsystems.description: Runtime token injection for custom canvas shaders, ambient orbs, window glass, and icon styles (Gothic, Matrix, Gold, Synthwave, FinTech)

subsystems.name: Juspay Hyperswitch™ Payment Router
subsystems.description: Live financial switch stream (1,842 TPS), bank routing rails (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis), and automated failover orchestration

subsystems.name: Morph Copilot AI Agent
subsystems.description: Autonomous OS copilot executing microkernel syscalls, querying telemetry, and performing system recompilation
